description:
Job Description: 
 Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc (AMA) is seeking a part-time intern to support the Flight Dynamics Research Facility at NASA Langley Research Center. The CAD Model Design Intern will support the Entry Systems Modeling project to develop free flight and forced oscillation model design for rapid prototype fabrication. Project activities include but are not limited to, forced oscillation and free flight tests to investigate the dynamic stability of blunt entry vehicles. The models to be tested include variations of geometries. Forced oscillation testing and free flight testing will provide static and dynamic stability data for the geometries tested as well as free flight dynamics which will serve as validation data for trajectory simulation analysis.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop models in in the form of .igs or .stp, as well as the native CAD format used for the design work
 Develop CAD models for oscillation configurations that include location of mounting interface at specified reference points,
 Design geometry to accommodate thermal inset fasteners for accurate and reliable mounting to the balance sting
 Create CAD solid models of free flight wind tunnel models using FDM 3D printing methods or similar.
 Design the models to enable a movable center of gravity
 Requirements 
 Undergraduate or Graduate student with a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering
 Minimum of 2 years’ experience in developing CAD models or 2 semesters of relevant CAD course

title: Internship - Fundraising
description:
Overview
Are you an aspiring change maker with a passion for mission and a curiosity for how fundraising really works? This year, step into a behind-the-scenes role where you'll see—and do—it all. As a Fundraising Intern, you'll get hands-on experience in every corner of nonprofit development: donor communications, events, strategy, stewardship, and more. You'll work alongside a mission-driven team dedicated to reenergizing the Catholic Church and see how generosity fuels impact at every level. Apply today to spend your summer learning the art and science of fundraising with one of the most impactful Catholic ministries in America.

title: Applications Engineering Co-op
description:
Position summary:
 The Applications Engineer Co-Op provides support to the Applications Engineering team in the preparation and organization of technical information during the bidding and proposal phases of material handling projects.
This role assists in reviewing bid packages, verifying that all required documents are complete and aligned with scope, and helping maintain the accuracy and consistency of project data used in pricing and estimating.
The Co-Op will participate in technical discussions, record key points from meetings, and assist with document tracking, Excel data management, and AutoCAD drawing reviews.
This position offers a learning opportunity for students pursuing an engineering degree who are interested in gaining hands-on exposure to industrial controls, power design, and material handling automation.
 
Tasks
·         Learn the fundamentals of material handling systems and electrical control architectures through direct involvement in live bid projects.
·         Assist Applications Engineers in verifying that all documentation received matches the project scope and RFQ requirements.
·         Track missing documents or open items and follow up with internal teams or vendors under the direction of the Applications Engineer.
·         Participate in technical meetings, taking organized notes of key points, questions, and assumptions to be considered in the bid.
·         Support the preparation of Excel-based estimating tools, cost summaries, and device
